title: Unity
definition: Unity is the shared life, love, truth, and mission believers have together in Christ through the Holy Spirit.
summary: Biblical unity is not built on ignoring truth but on shared faith in Christ, humility, love, and the Spirit's work among God's people.
christFocus: Christ prayed for the unity of His people and made them one body through His saving work.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Biblical unity is not built on ignoring truth but on shared faith in Christ, humility, love, and the Spirit's work among God's people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
